response.courseDescription: 430 X-ray Crystallography and Structural Biology An integrated physical, chemical and biochemical foundation for modern X-ray diffraction tools and techniques, and their application to structural biology. Credit not granted for both CHEM 430 and 530.
response.coursePrerequisites: CHEM 101 and 102 with a C or better, or CHEM 105 and 106 with a C or better.
